To add it to your calendar

On an iPhone or Mac: tap the invitation card above the attachment, then choose Add to Calendar. If you see only the file, tap invite.ics and confirm.

In Gmail: open the attachment at the foot of this letter, then choose Add to calendar.

Anywhere else: download invite.ics and open it. Every calendar of consequence knows what to do with it.

Once kept, your own calendar will alert you the evening before.
